name: Sleeping Beauty: The Kingdom of Lost Dreams
description:
People fall into deep sleeps from which they cannot wake up, and Aurora soon finds herself involved in a new adventure to save her people.

Together with her faithful friends, the fairies Flora, Fauna and Merryweather, and with the help of Felipe, Aurora discovers the existence of a hidden kingdom: The Kingdom of Lost Dreams, a mysterious and dangerous place where an ancient curse has unleashed chaos.

As they delve deeper into this dreamlike realm, Aurora will face challenges that will test her courage and her ability to overcome her own fears.
